title: Preserving Disagreement: Architectural Heterogeneity and Coherence Validation in Multi-Agent Policy Simulation
reasoning: The paper explores 'normative deliberation' in LLM-based multi-agent systems, focusing on how agents represent and maintain specific 'value perspectives' (e.g., Security Focus, Pragmatism) when evaluating policy scenarios like child welfare and housing. It evaluates the ability of these systems to preserve moral and ethical disagreement and navigate value-based trade-offs where no objectively correct answer exists.
